tagline: Their own padded seat for the drive, and their own bed when you get there.
lead: Your dog rides on around 10cm of memory foam, not a hard seat, and has their own bed when you arrive.
value: One thing does two jobs: a padded car seat on the road and a portable bed at the other end, so there is less to pack.
intro: Swallow is a memory foam dog car seat with a base of around 10cm of memory foam, a seat-belt channel, an adjustable headrest strap and a fabric cover that unclips to wash.
points: Memory foam underneath them, so they are not lying on a hard car seat.
A seat-belt channel and an adjustable headrest strap position the seat, and two inside clips are supplied.
It doubles as a portable bed, so they have somewhere of their own once you get there.
The fabric unclips and comes off to wash, while the foam stays out of the machine.
best_for: Small and medium dogs who fit the inside size and stated load, and owners who want one padded seat that also works as a travel bed.
fit_note: Inside it is about 66 × 38cm, with a stated total load of about 25kg. Check your dog, car and the fitting instructions first. It is not crash-tested: use an appropriate vehicle restraint and don't rely on the clips as crash protection.
care: Unclip the fabric and wash it as the care label says. Keep the foam out of the washing machine, and let every part dry fully before you refit it.
